title: 2026 Aldosterone Paradox (醛固酮悖論) 腎專主題精選與實戰模擬題庫

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the differential effect of Aldosterone on the distal nephron during Hypovolemia versus Hyperkalemia?

options.text: Hypovolemia predominantly increases sodium reabsorption without significant potassium wasting due to concurrent Angiotensin II action.
Hyperkalemia decreases Aldosterone secretion to prevent further potassium retention.
Angiotensin II acts synergistically with Aldosterone during Hyperkalemia to maximize potassium excretion.
Aldosterone paradox dictates that Hypovolemia leads to maximal potassium secretion regardless of Angiotensin II levels.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Hypovolemia 時，Angiotensin II 與 Aldosterone 同時升高。Angiotensin II 會活化 WNK4 與 NCC，促進鈉的重吸收，同時抑制 ROMK，防止過度鉀流失。相反地，在 Hyperkalemia 時，僅有 Aldosterone 升高，缺乏 Angiotensin II 的協同作用，導致 NCC 活性下降，大量鈉流向 CCD，進而最大化鉀的排泄。此現象被稱為 Aldosterone Paradox。

questions.stem: Regarding the potassium sensing mechanism in the Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT), how does the Kir4.1/Kir5.1 channel complex respond to Hypokalemia?

options.text: It depolarizes the basolateral membrane, activating ClC-Kb channels.
It hyperpolarizes the basolateral membrane, driving intracellular chloride exit and promoting WNK4 activation.
It hyperpolarizes the basolateral membrane, causing intracellular chloride accumulation.
It directly phosphorylates NCC independently of intracellular chloride concentration.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Hypokalemia 時，DCT 側底膜的 Kir4.1/Kir5.1 通道會導致細胞膜 Hyperpolarization。此電位變化驅使細胞內 Cl- 透過通道流出，當細胞內 Cl- 濃度下降時，會解除對 WNK4 的抑制，進而活化下游的 NCC 以保留鉀離子。

questions.stem: Under conditions of low intracellular Cl- concentration in the Distal Convoluted Tubule, which of the following signaling cascades is correctly described?

options.text: WNK4 is directly inhibited by binding to CUL3.
SPAK and OSR1 kinases are dephosphorylated and inactivated by WNK4.
WNK4 becomes active and phosphorylates SPAK and OSR1, which subsequently phosphorylate and activate NCC.
WNK1 forms an inhibitory complex with KLHL3 to prevent NCC phosphorylation.

questions.sourceExplanation: 當細胞內 Cl- 濃度下降時，Cl- 與 WNK4 的結合減少，解除對 WNK4 的抑制。活化的 WNK4 會磷酸化並活化 SPAK 與 OSR1，接著 SPAK/OSR1 會磷酸化 NCC 的 N 端，增加 NCC 在頂端膜的表現與活性。

questions.stem: How does Angiotensin II synergize with Aldosterone during volume depletion to conserve sodium without inducing hypokalemia?

options.text: Angiotensin II inhibits ENaC directly in the Principal Cells.
Angiotensin II suppresses WNK4 expression via SGK1 activation.
Angiotensin II induces rapid insertion of ROMK into the apical membrane.
Angiotensin II activates WNK4 to stimulate NCC, and simultaneously activates c-Src to inhibit ROMK in the Collecting Duct.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Volume Depletion 狀態下，Angiotensin II 扮演關鍵角色以防止 Aldosterone 造成的 K+ 流失。Angiotensin II 活化 WNK4 與 NCC 促進鈉重吸收，同時透過 c-Src 促進 ROMK 內吞，減少鉀排泄，從而達成保留鈉與體液但不流失鉀的目的。

questions.stem: During acute potassium loading, what is the primary mechanism leading to the dephosphorylation and rapid inactivation of NCC?

options.text: Activation of phosphatases such as Calcineurin (PP3) and PP2A, alongside GILZ downregulation.
Direct phosphorylation of NCC by SGK1 on serine residues.
Upregulation of Kir4.1/Kir5.1 activity leading to extreme hyperpolarization.
Binding of Angiotensin II to AT2 receptors in the Distal Convoluted Tubule.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Acute K+ Loading 時，為了迅速將鈉負載轉移至遠端以排鉀，NCC 必須被快速去磷酸化而失去活性。此過程涉及磷酸酶如 Calcineurin (PP3) 及 PP2A 的活化，同時 GILZ 等調節蛋白的參與也有助於 NCC 的去磷酸化與失活。

questions.stem: What is the physiological role of Mineralocorticoid Receptor (MR) Ser-843 phosphorylation in Type B Intercalated Cells?

options.text: It activates MR to promote Pendrin insertion during hyperkalemia.
It acts as a switch; phosphorylation inhibits MR ligand binding, preventing Aldosterone action during volume depletion.
It enhances MR binding to Aldosterone in Principal Cells.
It triggers apoptosis of Type B Intercalated Cells during systemic acidosis.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Type B Intercalated Cells 中，MR 在 Ser-843 位點的磷酸化具有開關功能。當 Ser-843 被磷酸化時，MR 無法與 Aldosterone 結合而被抑制；在 Volume Depletion 時，此位點去磷酸化，使得 Aldosterone 能活化 MR，進而促進 Pendrin 的表現以吸收 Cl-。

questions.stem: Which combination of transporters mediates electroneutral NaCl reabsorption in the Cortical Collecting Duct (CCD) without driving potassium excretion?

options.text: ENaC and ROMK
NCC and Kir4.1
Pendrin (SLC26A4) and NDCBE (SLC4A8)
NHE3 and ClC-Ka

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 CCD 中，Type B Intercalated Cells 透過頂端膜的 Pendrin (SLC26A4, 進行 Cl-/HCO3- 交換) 與 SLC4A8 (NDCBE, 進行 Na+-dependent Cl-/HCO3- 交換) 協同運作，達成 Electroneutral NaCl Reabsorption。因為此過程不產生跨膜電位差 (Lumen-negative potential)，故不會驅使鉀離子透過 ROMK 流失。

questions.stem: Which of the following genetic mutations is a known cause of Gordon Syndrome (Pseudohypoaldosteronism Type 2)?

options.text: Loss-of-function mutation in ENaC beta-subunit
Gain-of-function mutation in the Mineralocorticoid Receptor
Loss-of-function mutation in 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2
Mutations in WNK1, WNK4, KLHL3, or CUL3 leading to NCC overactivation

questions.sourceExplanation: Gordon Syndrome (Pseudohypoaldosteronism Type 2, PHA2 或 FHHt) 的致病基因包含 WNK1, WNK4, KLHL3, 與 CUL3。KLHL3/CUL3 複合體正常情況下負責降解 WNK 激酶，這些基因突變會導致 WNK 降解減少或 WNK4 功能改變，最終造成 NCC 過度活化，引發高血壓、高血鉀與代謝性酸中毒。

questions.stem: A patient diagnosed with Gordon Syndrome is evaluated for optimal pharmacological treatment. Which of the following responses to therapy is most characteristic of this condition?

options.text: Exquisite sensitivity and prompt correction of hypertension and hyperkalemia with low-dose Thiazides.
Rapid normalization of blood pressure with high-dose Spironolactone.
Significant worsening of hyperkalemia when treated with Furosemide.
Symptom resolution following physiological doses of Fludrocortisone.

questions.sourceExplanation: Gordon Syndrome (FHHt) 的病理機轉為 NCC 過度活化。因此，這類患者對於極低劑量的 Thiazides 具有極高的敏感性 (Exquisite sensitivity)，使用 Thiazides 能迅速且有效地矯正其 Hypertension 與 Hyperkalemia。Fludrocortisone 無效且可能惡化高血壓。

questions.stem: How does Serum and Glucocorticoid-regulated Kinase 1 (SGK1) enhance sodium reabsorption in the Principal Cells of the collecting duct?

options.text: By phosphorylating NCC directly to increase its half-life.
By phosphorylating and inhibiting Nedd4-2, thereby preventing the ubiquitination and degradation of ENaC.
By dephosphorylating the Mineralocorticoid Receptor to increase its nuclear translocation.
By acting as an endocytic adaptor protein for ROMK retrieval.

questions.sourceExplanation: Aldosterone 進入 Principal Cells 後會促進 SGK1 的轉錄與表現。SGK1 能夠磷酸化 Nedd4-2，使其失去與 ENaC 結合的能力，進而阻止 ENaC 被 Ubiquitination 與降解。這導致 ENaC 在頂端膜的密度增加，促進鈉的重吸收。

questions.stem: During states of potassium restriction, how is ROMK (KCNJ1) channel activity downregulated in the distal nephron?

options.text: Direct degradation by the KLHL3/CUL3 ubiquitin ligase complex.
Upregulation of ROMK mRNA cleavage by microRNAs.
Tyrosine phosphorylation by c-Src and c-Yes, leading to increased channel endocytosis.
Dephosphorylation by Calcineurin (PP3) resulting in channel closure.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Potassium Restriction 時，為了減少鉀的流失，ROMK 必須從頂端膜移除。此過程受到 Tyrosine Kinases (如 c-Src 與 c-Yes) 的調控；這些激酶將 ROMK 磷酸化後，會誘發 ROMK 的 Endocytosis，從而降低鉀排泄。

questions.stem: Which of the following processes is crucial for the maximal activation of the Epithelial Sodium Channel (ENaC) at the apical membrane?

options.text: Phosphorylation of the alpha subunit by PKA.
Ubiquitination of the gamma subunit by Nedd4-2.
Internalization via Clathrin-coated pits.
Proteolytic cleavage of the alpha and gamma subunits by serine proteases such as Prostasin or Tissue Kallikrein.

questions.sourceExplanation: ENaC 由 alpha, beta, gamma 三個次單位組成。要達到最大活化狀態，alpha 與 gamma 次單位必須在細胞外側被 Serine Proteases (如 Furin, Prostasin, Tissue Kallikrein 等) 進行 Proteolytic Cleavage，這會改變通道構型並大幅增加通道的開放機率 (Open probability)。

questions.stem: What is the primary physiological distinction between electrogenic and electroneutral NaCl reabsorption in the distal nephron?

options.text: Electrogenic reabsorption via ENaC generates a lumen-negative potential driving K+ and H+ excretion, whereas electroneutral reabsorption via Pendrin/SLC4A8 does not.
Electroneutral reabsorption requires Aldosterone, while electrogenic reabsorption is entirely Aldosterone-independent.
Electrogenic reabsorption occurs exclusively in the DCT, while electroneutral reabsorption occurs only in the PCT.
Electroneutral reabsorption via NCC strongly drives Mg2+ secretion, whereas electrogenic reabsorption conserves Mg2+.

questions.sourceExplanation: 透過 ENaC 進行的鈉重吸收是 Electrogenic 的，會產生 Lumen-negative potential，進而成為驅動 K+ (經 ROMK) 與 H+ (經 H+-ATPase) 排出的原動力。相反地，Type B Intercalated Cells 透過 Pendrin 與 SLC4A8 進行的 Electroneutral NaCl Reabsorption 不會改變管腔電位，因此不會促使 K+ 流失。

questions.stem: Why does a patient with Primary Hyperaldosteronism typically present with severe hypokalemia, whereas a patient with Secondary Hyperaldosteronism due to heart failure rarely exhibits significant K+ wasting?

options.text: Heart failure patients have increased dietary potassium intake.
In heart failure, severe volume depletion limits distal sodium delivery, impairing the electrogenic exchange needed for K+ excretion.
Primary hyperaldosteronism is associated with a concomitant increase in Angiotensin II, which maximizes K+ secretion.
Heart failure causes downregulation of Mineralocorticoid Receptors in the ASDN.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Primary Hyperaldosteronism (如 Conn Syndrome) 中，患者通常呈現 Volume Expansion，使得近端腎小管鈉重吸收減少，大量鈉流向遠端，加上 Aldosterone 活化 ENaC，產生強大的 Lumen-negative potential，造成嚴重 Hypokalemia。相反地，在 Heart Failure (Secondary Hyperaldosteronism) 時，Effective Arterial Blood Volume (EABV) 降低，近端鈉重吸收極高，到達遠端的鈉量大幅減少 (Decreased distal delivery of sodium)，因此即使 Aldosterone 很高，也無法產生足夠的電位差來驅動 K+ 流失。

questions.stem: Which of the following comparisons between Aldosterone antagonists (Spironolactone) and ENaC inhibitors (Amiloride) is accurate?

options.text: Spironolactone acts from the tubular lumen, while Amiloride must enter the cell to block transcription.
Amiloride prevents MR nuclear translocation, whereas Spironolactone directly blocks the pore of ENaC.
Spironolactone blocks the Mineralocorticoid Receptor competitively in the cytoplasm, whereas Amiloride blocks the ENaC pore directly from the luminal side.
Both agents cause severe hypokalemia due to increased distal sodium delivery.

questions.sourceExplanation: Spironolactone 與 Eplerenone 是 MR Antagonists，經由血液循環進入細胞質內競爭性地阻斷 MR 的活化；而 Amiloride 與 Triamterene 是 ENaC Inhibitors，直接在管腔側 (Luminal side) 物理性地阻擋 ENaC 的孔道。兩者皆為 Potassium-sparing Diuretics，不會造成 Hypokalemia。

questions.stem: In Type A Intercalated Cells, how does the H+/K+-ATPase respond to systemic potassium depletion compared to systemic acidosis?

options.text: It is downregulated in both conditions to prevent further ion imbalances.
It exclusively secretes potassium during acidosis.
Systemic acidosis inhibits its expression, while potassium depletion solely activates H+-ATPase.
Potassium depletion strongly upregulates H+/K+-ATPase to reabsorb K+ at the expense of H+ secretion, contributing to hypokalemic alkalosis.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Potassium Depletion 的情況下，Type A Intercalated Cells 會大幅增加 H+/K+-ATPase 的表現與活性。這個幫浦會將管腔中的 K+ 重吸收回細胞，同時將細胞內的 H+ 排出至管腔。因此，嚴重的 Hypokalemia 常常會伴隨發生 Metabolic Alkalosis (Hypokalemic Alkalosis)。

questions.stem: Following chronic administration of Thiazide diuretics or in genetic NCC knockout models, what compensatory intersegmental crosstalk occurs in the distal nephron?

options.text: Hypertrophy of the Connecting Tubule (CNT) and Cortical Collecting Duct (CCD) with upregulation of ENaC to increase distal sodium reabsorption.
Atrophy of the Connecting Tubule and decreased expression of ROMK.
Decreased Renin secretion from the Juxtaglomerular Apparatus due to macula densa sensing.
Downregulation of Pendrin to minimize electroneutral NaCl uptake.

questions.sourceExplanation: 長期使用 Thiazides 或是 NCC 基因剔除 (如 Gitelman Syndrome 模型) 會導致 DCT 萎縮與功能低下。作為代償，更遠端的節段如 CNT 與 CCD 會發生 Hypertrophy，並且 ENaC 的表現量會顯著上升 (Upregulation)，以試圖回收流失的鈉離子。這種 Intersegmental Crosstalk 是造成長期利尿劑抗性 (Diuretic Resistance) 的原因之一。

questions.stem: Which novel feed-forward mechanism rapidly enhances renal potassium excretion following a potassium-rich meal, prior to significant increases in plasma Aldosterone?

options.text: Direct inhibition of ENaC by elevated insulin levels.
Gut/hepatoportal potassium sensing that releases a circulating factor, leading to Tissue Kallikrein-mediated activation of apical potassium channels.
Immediate downregulation of the Na+/K+-ATPase in the basolateral membrane.
Decreased GFR mediated by the tubuloglomerular feedback mechanism.

questions.sourceExplanation: 研究指出，在進食富含鉀的食物後 (Postprandial state)，腸道或肝門脈系統 (Gut/hepatoportal potassium sensing) 會偵測到鉀攝取，並在血清鉀或 Aldosterone 顯著上升前，釋放未知的循環因子 (Gut factor)。此機制會促使腎臟釋放 Tissue Kallikrein 等蛋白酶，進而切割並活化 ENaC 等通道，快速促進 Kaliuresis 以避免餐後高血鉀。
